title: Vignette 2026-11-10: how affirmations work needs a clear open exercise

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: The rebel's question about the affirmation process is a very important one. We need to mainatian a clear open exercise about how affirmations work. There is a lot of conversation in the programme about them.

sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-11-10; recorded verbatim. Responds to the Rebel's question in the review of the six session-agenda exercises: 'Should affirming a record change its standing, or create a second record?' (duplicate domain pairs such as 346e323e / 3576be41 are a suggestion and its affirmed copy). Related vignette 993cfb4f.
